name: spinner
title: Spinner
description: Loading indicators: the iOS activity indicator (eight fading spokes in discrete steps, the default) and twenty-two CSS loaders with three variants each: seven ported from Dani Asyrofi's Loading (Orbit, Bars, Matrix, Merge, Encode, Scan, Lift) and fifteen of BL UI's own (Steps, Cradle, Hourglass, Balance, Fanout, Battery, Bloom, Sonar, Gyro, Coalesce, Crystal, Loop, Relay, Robot, Kettle). They draw in currentColor, scale to any size, take a speed, pause themselves off screen, and hold still under reduced motion.
